Definition: from G3844 and G1096; to become near, i.e. approach (have arrived); by implication, to appear publicly:--come, go, be present.
BiblicalUsage: Paraginomai means to come, to arrive, to be present. Saul comes to Jerusalem and tries to join himself to the disciples, but they are afraid of him; and years later Paul comes to Jerusalem to bring alms to his nation and offerings.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Paul's two arrivals frame his whole ministry: first he comes and is feared as a persecutor, then he comes bearing gifts for his people.
